title: A Review of Multi-Modal Large Language and Vision Models
measurement_description: The paper does not conduct its own measurements but notes that the CrowS-Pairs benchmark can be used to review Large Language Models for biases across various areas, including religion. This benchmark assesses a model's response and perplexity to examples created using both a stereotype and an anti-stereotype.
findings: The paper does not report specific findings related to religion. It only mentions that benchmarks like CrowS-Pairs exist to evaluate biases in areas such as religion, but it provides no results from such evaluations.
